content_sections.heading: About MDD Maharashtra
content_sections.text: The Minority Development Department of the Government of Maharashtra works from Room No. 528, Mantralaya (Extension Building), Madam Cama Marg, Hutatma Rajguru Chowk, Mumbai 400 032. This notice is for posts in the Maulana Azad Minority Economic Development Corporation, Mumbai. The posts will be filled on deputation under the provisions of General Administration Department Government Resolution No. एआरव्ही-२०११/प्र.क्र.१३७/कार्यासन-१२ dated 17 December 2016.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Address: Room No. 528, Mantralaya (Extension Building), Madam Cama Marg, Hutatma Rajguru Chowk, Mumbai 400 032 Telephone: 022 22830626 Email: [email protected] Website: mdd.maharashtra.gov.in The proforma ends with the name, designation and signature of the head of department. It asks for the following 15 items: Full name and designation of the officer or employee Pay scale in which pay is currently drawn Name, address and telephone number of the present office Date of birth Date of first appointment Date of retirement Educational qualification Contact details (mobile and email ID) Photocopies of the confidential reports of the last five years from 2025-26 Whether the statement of assets and liabilities (as on 31.03.2026) has been submitted Whether the 50/55-year review has been done Details of any earlier deputation of the officer: from date to date, post, and place of deputation (office) Whether a departmental inquiry is in progress or proposed Whether the officer was earlier found guilty in a departmental inquiry or by a court Whether the department will relieve the officer if selected for deputation

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MDD Maharashtra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies, one each for Managing Director, Joint Managing Director, Manager, Deputy Manager, Accounts Officer Class-2 and Deputy Accounts Officer in the Maulana Azad Minority Economic Development Corporation, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted within 3 weeks from the date of publication of the advertisement. The notice is dated 26 November 2026, so the deadline is about 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these deputation posts?
faq.answer: Officers and employees in the equivalent pay scale in field offices subordinate to Mantralaya departments may apply. The Accounts Officer Class-2 and Deputy Accounts Officer posts are for officers of the Directorate of Accounts and Treasuries under the Finance Department.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is needed for the Accounts Officer Class-2 and Deputy Accounts Officer posts?
faq.answer: Accounts Officer Class-2 needs at least two years in the Accounts Officer cadre. Deputy Accounts Officer needs at least two years in the Assistant Accounts Officer cadre. Both cadres are in the Directorate of Accounts and Treasuries.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for the Managing Director post?
faq.answer: The Managing Director post is linked to the 6th Pay Commission pay scale with Grade Pay ₹7,600/- (Pay Scale Rs. 15,600-39,100). Joint Managing Director is at Grade Pay ₹6,600/- (Rs. 15,600-38,800).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for MDD Maharashtra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the proforma for deputation attached to the notice and get it approved and signed by your head of department. Then submit it within 3 weeks from the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent appointment?
faq.answer: No. All six posts are to be filled by appointment on deputation, under General Administration Department Government Resolution dated 17 December 2016.

faq.question: Q8. What documents must be attached to the application?
faq.answer: Attach photocopies of the confidential reports of the last five years from 2025-26 to the proforma. The proforma also asks whether the statement of assets and liabilities as on 31.03.2026 has been submitted.
